title: Every Block Gear
description: this mod add gear for every blocks! tools and armor
body:
This mod will add equipment to every block in the game. Each block will have its own weapons and tools! (This mod is designed just for fun with friends.)
Currently, the mod adds equipment from: _**air, granite, diorite, andesite, deepslate, tuff, calcite, dripstone, grass, dirt, moss, bedrock, sand, magma, obsidian, blackstone, raw iron, and gold**_. _Not all equipment has individual textures yet_ (most have a pattern temporarily, but I'm slowly working on the textures. Please wait.)
